committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects elementary and secondary schools receiving federal education funds that have partnerships or support tied to the Chinese government.
dimensions.evidence: no funds may be made available under an applicable program to any elementary school or secondary school that has a partnership in effect with a cultural or language institute

dimensions.assessment: Potentially cuts off federal education funding for affected schools unless a waiver is granted.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits federal education funding for any elementary or secondary school that directly or indirectly receives support from the Chinese government.

dimensions.assessment: Reallocates or withholds applicable federal education program funds from non-compliant schools, though exact aggregate dollar figures are not specified.
dimensions.evidence: no funds may be made available under an applicable program to any elementary school or secondary school

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a new statutory funding prohibition and a waiver mechanism administered by the Department of Education.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary, upon receipt of a request submitted under subparagraph (A), may issue a waiver to the school

dimensions.assessment: Permanent funding restriction taking effect one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The prohibition under subsection (a) shall take effect on the date that is one year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Number of schools currently receiving support from the Chinese government.
Total dollar amount of federal funds subject to restriction.
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits federal education funds for elementary and secondary schools receiving direct or indirect support from the Chinese government, subject to a waiver process.

related.label: H.Res. 916
related.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 4312) to protect the name, image, and likeness rights of student athletes and to promote fair competition with respect to intercollegiate athletics, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1005) to prohibit elementary and secondary schools from accepting funds from or entering into contracts with the Government of the People’s Republic of China and the Chinese Communist Party, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1049) to ensure that parents are aware of foreign influence in their child’s public school, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1069) to prohibit the availability of Federal education funds for elementary and secondary schools that receive direct or indirect support from the Government of the People’s Republic of China; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2965) to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to ensure that the small business regulatory budget for a small business concern in a fiscal year is not greater than zero, and for other purposes; and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 4305) to direct the Chief Counsel for Advocacy of the Small Business Administration to establish a Red Tape Hotline to receive notifications of burdensome agency rules, and for other purposes.
